appliedUpdates.description: Add documentation about SRGB vs UNORM texture formats for color space handling in graphics rendering
appliedUpdates.evidence: Worker discovered that font atlas texture format mismatch (UNORM instead of SRGB) caused semi-transparent rendering. White pixel [255,255,255,255] in SRGB space samples as pure white (1.0,1.0,1.0,1.0). Using UNORM would cause the white to be interpreted as linear-space white, which renders semi-transparent when blended with SRGB render targets.

appliedUpdates.description: Add documentation about shader texture modulation pattern (output = color * texture_sample) used in UI rendering
appliedUpdates.evidence: Worker identified the shader's texture sampling logic: output = color * texture_sample. This relationship between vertex color modulation and texture sampling for solid color rendering is important for understanding the UI rendering pipeline.

appliedUpdates.description: Add documentation about white pixel sampling technique for solid color UI rendering
appliedUpdates.evidence: Worker discovered that solid color UI rendering uses UV=(0,0) to sample a white pixel from the font atlas, then modulates with vertex color. This white pixel technique is a common pattern for efficient solid color rendering.

featureReviews.summary: Correctly diagnosed UNORM vs SRGB texture format mismatch as root cause of transparency issues. One-line fix (rgba8_unorm → rgba8_srgb) with comprehensive test coverage. Addresses VAL-OPACITY-001 and VAL-OPACITY-002.

Correctly fixed HiDPI scissor coordinate handling by adding scale_factor field to UIDrawList and multiplying clip_rect when setting Vulkan scissor. Maintains logical/physical pixel separation. Addresses VAL-POS-002 and FLOW-002.
Correctly fixed clear_cache() to use 2x2 white pixel pattern consistent with other initialization methods. Minimal, focused changes with comprehensive test coverage. Addresses VAL-ATLAS-001.
